title: NetherEscapes

body:
# ![nether with bedrock ceiling](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/debe6f34abb77522f26a5699aaa5061fbf7af57a_0.webp) NetherEscapes

A high-performance, lightweight utility for **Paper 1.21.x** (and the **26.x** series) that provides a balanced way for players to escape the Nether bedrock roof.

---

### ❓ The Problem
In multiplayer environments, players can occasionally clip through the Nether ceiling. Since vanilla portal pairing is often restricted on servers, these players become stranded, resulting in constant support tickets for staff to manually teleport them down.

### 🚀 The Solution: `/escapeit`
**NetherEscape** automates this process with a focus on server balance and security.

* **🛡️ Anti-Combat Warmup:** Players must stand still for **3 seconds**. If they move or take damage, the teleport is cancelled.
* **🔍 Smart Safety Scan:** The plugin searches for a solid "shore" block within a 3-meter radius to ensure players don't land in lava.
* **📍 Condition-Based:** The command only functions if the player is in the Nether and above **Y=125**.

---

### 🛠️ Commands & Permissions

| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/escapeit` | Initiates the 3-second escape sequence. | Not Needed! |
